Method of Attack: Unauthenticated attackers can exploit it to access backup infrastructure hosts after obtaining encrypted credentials stored in the VeeamVBR configuration database
Allows unauthenticated users to request encrypted credentials via Veeam.Backup.Service.exe running on TCP 9401
Impacted Systems: Veeam Backup & Replication (VBR) versions V11 and V12
Attack Vector: Unauthenticated access to Veeam.Backup.Service.exe on TCP port 9401
